headline: Low interaction risk: no shared write, network, or clipboard channels are exposed, so prompt injection and leakage pathways are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Great Expectations has file-based I/O only and no shared channel is shown; Whisper has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, or filesystem read/write surfaces. Without a bridge, A cannot inject instructions into B in the default pair.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies A's output into B, injection becomes possible.
IF a shared filesystem or message queue is added, A's content can reach B.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Avoid manual copy-paste of generated text into downstream prompts.
Do not add a shared MCP or queue without provenance tags.
Review any future file bridge before enabling it.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A touches validation results and documentation, while B touches audio/speech only and cannot read files or send network traffic. The pair lacks a default data path, so leakage is limited to unusual operator-created bridges rather than routine execution.
conditions: IF the operator exports A's files into B's audio inputs, those contents may be exposed in transcripts.
IF a shared workspace is introduced, file contents can cross between agents.
mitigations: Keep sensitive validation outputs out of shared folders.
Run B with no file access, as profiled.
Do not route A's artifacts through B unless redacted.
Separate credentials and accounts for each agent.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: A can install packages and write files, but B cannot write files, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. There is no overlapping mutable surface, so the pair cannot conflict over the same state in the profiled default.
conditions: IF B is replaced with a writable variant, write conflicts may appear.
IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable directory, A can overwrite B's outputs.
mitigations: Do not mount the same writable directory into both agents.
Serialize any future writes through one owner process.
Use separate git worktrees if write access is later added.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Great Expectations produces validation results and documentation, but Whisper is a speech model with no action-taking authority or documented parser that would automatically trust A's outputs. Any cascade would require an external orchestrator to treat A as authoritative.
conditions: IF an external workflow feeds A's text into B as instructions, cascade risk increases.
IF B is wrapped by an orchestrator that acts on transcripts without verification, errors can propagate.
mitigations: Insert a human or rule-based verification step between agents.
Keep A's outputs labeled as data, not instructions.
Do not automate downstream actions from B's transcripts without checks.

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are open-source, docs-only, and show no secrets, OAuth scopes, or network egress. No residency, certification, retention, or PHI mismatch is evidenced, so the compliance pathway is not established for this pair.
conditions: IF future deployments route regulated data into either agent, compliance review is required.
IF retention or residency settings are added externally, they must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Document the data classes each agent may process.
Keep regulated data out of both agents unless reviewed.
Recheck residency and retention before deployment.
